name: Verify Password Registration Email
summary: Consumes the active email verification proof and establishes verified ownership.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == verification-required and pending-identity-flow == password and email-ownership == verification-pending

setup: Issue a valid email verification proof bound to the PendingIdentity.

postconditions.expression: email-ownership == verified and pending-identity-status == resolution-required and session-capability == identity-ceremony
